issues.description: The script establishes and manipulates a WebSocket connection to garticphone.com, sending drawing data and possibly user actions. All transmissions are to the first-party domain only.
issues.recommendation: Ensure only intended game data is sent. No evidence of third-party exfiltration.

issues.description: The script requests @grant GM_xmlhttpRequest but does not use it in the code, which is a higher-than-needed permission.
issues.recommendation: Remove unused GM_xmlhttpRequest grant to reduce attack surface.

issues.description: The script uses unsafeWindow to override the WebSocket constructor, which is necessary for its function but increases risk if the page is compromised.
issues.recommendation: Limit unsafeWindow usage and ensure no exposure of sensitive functions to the page context.

summary: 该脚本主要通过 WebSocket 与 garticphone.com 官方服务器通信，仅发送游戏相关的绘图数据，无第三方数据外传或隐私采集行为。未发现代码混淆、DOM XSS、远程代码执行等高危问题。存在权限过度申请（GM_xmlhttpRequest 未使用）和对 unsafeWindow 的必要但敏感操作。整体风险较低，建议移除未用权限并关注后续更新。
